scenario: A regulatory affairs team evaluates the embryofetal developmental (EFD) toxicology package for a new small-molecule compound prior to IND submission. The workflow cleans and standardizes multi-species EFD study datasets (rat and rabbit), runs an ADMET/developmental toxicity profile, and generates a REMS pregnancy-category recommendation report for internal regulatory decision-making.
info_flow: clinical-data-cleaner standardizes the multi-species EFD study CSV (rat + rabbit) → admet-prediction reads the cleaned data and computes a developmental toxicity risk category and REMS recommendation → reporting generates a structured regulatory readiness report.
